input.summary: Invoice 000903-A from Voyageur Corporate Travel (CAD 5,574.37, dated 2026-07-06) looks like a duplicate of invoice 000903 (AP-00277, dated 2026-07-04), which was already paid. The earlier invoice was paid by Brim card charge CT-00391 on 2026-07-20 for the same amount, CAD 5,574.37. The new invoice is also stale: it arrived 2026-10-27, 113 days after its date. The invoice stays on hold. There are no approvals recorded on it, and the supplier has no bank details or bank changes on file, so this looks like a card-paid supplier.
open_questions: Is 000903-A a genuine re-bill, a resend of 000903 with a suffix, or a different service?
Did Voyageur confirm the 2026-07-20 card charge CT-00391 covers invoice 000903?
Why did the invoice arrive 113 days after its date?
Earlier invoice 000896 was also entered twice (AP-00219 settled, AP-00237 rejected). Is there a recurring duplicate-entry pattern with this supplier?
